glosses.notes: Used to say what is proper, expected, or right to do.

examples.sentence: 学生应当先预习，再上课。
有问题应当马上问老师。

example_translations.translation: Students should preview first and then go to class.
If you have questions, you should ask the teacher right away.
We ought to explain things clearly.

glosses.notes: To go receive someone or something and welcome them.

examples.sentence: 大家在门口迎接新老师。
学校准备迎接外国学生。

example_translations.translation: Everyone welcomed the new teacher at the door.
I went to the station to meet my family.
The school is getting ready to greet foreign students.

glosses.notes: The useful nourishment that food gives the body.

examples.sentence: 孩子每天都要吃有营养的饭。

example_translations.translation: Children need to eat nutritious meals every day.
The doctor said this soup is very nutritious.
Breakfast was too simple, so it did not provide enough nutrition.

glosses.notes: To defeat others in a game, match, or competition.

example_translations.translation: Our class won the match yesterday.
He wants to win this game.
In the end, we still won.

glosses.notes: Refers to movies, television, and related screen production.

examples.sentence: 他以后想做影视这一行。

example_translations.translation: She is taking a film and television class at school.
This film or television work is very well known.
He wants to go into film and television in the future.

glosses.notes: Often means to apply something in practice; it can also mean an app or application.

examples.sentence: 老师教我们把新方法应用到工作中。
这个技术已经应用在医院里。
这个应用很好用，我天天打开。

example_translations.translation: The teacher taught us to apply the new method in our work.
This technology is already being put to use in hospitals.
This app is very useful, and I open it every day.

glosses.notes: A good quality or clear positive side of someone or something.

examples.sentence: 这家店的优点是离学校近。

example_translations.translation: His strong point is that he is very serious about things.
The advantage of this shop is that it is close to the school.
This book has many strong points.

glosses.notes: A stronger position or clear edge over others.

examples.sentence: 这就是我们的最大优势。
她在语言方面很有优势。
价格低是这家店的优势。

example_translations.translation: This is our biggest advantage.
She has a real edge in languages.
Low prices are this shop's advantage.

glosses.notes: Often used to show who does something or who is responsible for it.

example_translations.translation: This book was written by the teacher.
I'll make dinner.
Who will do this job?

glosses.notes: Used to introduce the reason or cause of something.

examples.sentence: 由于时间不多，他先走了。
由于身体不太好，她今天请假了。

example_translations.translation: Because of the rain, we did not go out.
Due to limited time, he left first.
Because she was not feeling very well, she took leave today.

glosses.notes: Used for mail in general and very often for email messages.

examples.sentence: 我已经收到你的邮件了。
老师昨天发了一封邮件。

example_translations.translation: I already received your email.
The teacher sent an email yesterday.
I have not read this message yet.

glosses.notes: A stamp used for mailing letters or one collected as an item.

example_translations.translation: This stamp is new.
He likes collecting old stamps.
I bought two foreign stamps.

glosses.notes: Can mean a physical mailbox or an email inbox depending on context.

examples.sentence: 请把文件发到我邮箱里。

example_translations.translation: Please send the file to my inbox.
My inbox is very full today.
Check the mailbox first.

glosses.notes: The simple verb for moving or floating through water.

examples.sentence: 孩子们在河里游来游去。

example_translations.translation: The little fish swims very fast in the water.
He can swim, so he is not afraid of water.
The children keep swimming back and forth in the river.

glosses.notes: A game or playful activity, including video games and simple games.

examples.sentence: 我们周末一起做个小游戏吧。

example_translations.translation: This game is very interesting.
I like this game very much.
Let's play a little game together this weekend.

glosses.notes: To swim as an activity, exercise, or hobby.

examples.sentence: 夏天我最想去海边游泳。

example_translations.translation: He goes swimming every morning.
In summer I most want to go swimming by the sea.
The doctor said swimming is good for the body.

glosses.notes: An expression meaning there is a lot of something and no shortage of it.

example_translations.translation: I have plenty of this kind of book at home.
Plenty of people want to eat fruit.
There are plenty of people willing to help you.

glosses.notes: Describes something that helps, supports, or gives an advantage.

examples.sentence: 这个办法对学习很有利。

example_translations.translation: Going to bed early and getting up early is beneficial to the body.
This method is very beneficial for study.
Previewing carefully is favorable for class.

glosses.notes: Describes something that works well or remains valid.

example_translations.translation: This method is very effective.
This study method is very effective.
This ticket is still valid tomorrow.

glosses.notes: A prediction or report about what is expected, often about weather.

example_translations.translation: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
I read the forecast every morning.
The forecast says tonight will be colder.

glosses.notes: To stop an illness or problem before it happens.

examples.sentence: 运动对预防很多病有用。

example_translations.translation: Washing your hands more can prevent illness.
The doctor told us to prevent colds.
Exercise is useful for preventing many illnesses.

glosses.notes: To estimate or expect something based on what is known now.

example_translations.translation: We estimate that we will arrive at three in the afternoon.
The teacher expects that he will come.
The company expects next month to be even busier.

glosses.notes: To study a lesson before class.

examples.sentence: 老师让我们先预习课文。
预习以后，上课更容易懂。

example_translations.translation: The teacher told us to preview the text first.
I preview my lessons every evening.
After previewing, class is easier to understand.

glosses.primary_gloss: suffix indicating a member or personnel
glosses.notes: A suffix used in words for members, staff, or people in a role.

examples.sentence: 他已经是这里的会员了。

example_translations.translation: The employees of this shop have all arrived.
Two team members are still training.
He is already a member here.

glosses.notes: A person who works for a company or organization.

example_translations.translation: This company has many employees.
New staff members first learn from the teacher.
The employees eat lunch together at noon.

glosses.notes: A wish, hope, or strongly wanted goal.

examples.sentence: 我的愿望是去北京读书。
她小时候的愿望是当老师。
我希望他的愿望能实现。

example_translations.translation: My wish is to go study in Beijing.
Her childhood wish was to become a teacher.
I hope his wish can come true.

glosses.notes: To arrange a meeting time with someone.

example_translations.translation: I arranged to meet my friend tomorrow.
We agreed to meet at the school gate.
He wants to make an appointment to talk with the teacher.

glosses.notes: A music group that performs together.

examples.sentence: 我们晚上去听乐队演出。

example_translations.translation: This band is very young.
We are going to hear the band perform tonight.
He wants to join a band.

glosses.notes: To move goods or people from one place to another.

examples.sentence: 这些水果今天就要运输出去。
这家公司运输东西很快。

example_translations.translation: These fruits need to be transported out today.
This company transports goods very quickly.
Rain will make shipping slower.

glosses.notes: A magazine, often about a topic like travel, music, or news.

example_translations.translation: I often read magazines on the bus.
This magazine is about travel.
She bought a music magazine.

glosses.notes: Shows that something happened much earlier than now.

examples.sentence: 我早已把这本书看完了。
老师来以前，他早已到了。

example_translations.translation: I finished this book long ago.
He had heard the news long before.
He had arrived long before the teacher came.

glosses.notes: To make or build something.

example_translations.translation: This factory builds cars.
People use wood to build houses.
He wants to make a table himself.

glosses.notes: To cause a result or bring about a situation, often a problem.

examples.sentence: 这件小事也会造成问题。

example_translations.translation: Heavy rain caused many problems.
This small matter can also cause problems.
This matter brought about quite a few changes.

glosses.notes: A duty or obligation that someone should take seriously.

examples.sentence: 他愿意把责任放在自己身上。

example_translations.translation: This is my responsibility.
Parents have responsibilities toward their children.
He is willing to put the responsibility on himself.

glosses.notes: To make something become more in amount, number, or time.

examples.sentence: 学校今年增加了两个班。
我们想增加一点儿时间。

example_translations.translation: The school added two classes this year.
We want to add a little more time.
The number of customers in the shop increased.

glosses.notes: To rise or grow over time, often in number, amount, or level.

examples.sentence: 这几年工资增长得很快。
来这家店的人增长了不少。
公司的生意一直在增长。

example_translations.translation: Wages have grown quickly these past few years.
The number of people coming to this shop increased quite a lot.
The company's business has been growing steadily.

glosses.notes: To open something out, spread it, or begin something in a fuller way.

examples.sentence: 他把信展开以后才说话。
两个人展开了长时间的谈话。

example_translations.translation: Please unfold the map and take a look.
He unfolded the letter before speaking.
The two people began a long conversation.

glosses.notes: Used in actions like opening the mouth or spreading something open.

examples.sentence: 他一进门就张大眼睛看。

example_translations.translation: The doctor told him to open his mouth wide.
As soon as the wind blew, the paper spread open.
As soon as he came in, he opened his eyes wide and looked.

glosses.notes: Often used to mean doing something based on a plan, words, or a method.

example_translations.translation: Just do it according to the teacher's words.
Tomorrow we will leave according to the plan.
From now on, do everything in accordance with this method.

glosses.primary_gloss: suffix indicating a person who does something
glosses.notes: A suffix used in words for people who do something or belong to a role.

example_translations.translation: The reporter has already arrived.
This book has many readers.
Many volunteers came to help.

glosses.notes: Describes something that is real, true, and not made up.

example_translations.translation: This is a real story.
I want to know the real situation.
What he said felt very genuine.

glosses.notes: To argue, struggle, or compete for something.

examples.sentence: 这两个人又为钱争起来了。

example_translations.translation: Everyone wants to fight for first place.
These two people started arguing over money again.
Do not keep arguing over small things.

glosses.notes: To make an active effort to get something good or important.

examples.sentence: 我们要争取更好的结果。

example_translations.translation: We need to strive for a better result.
He is working to win everyone's support.
I will try to arrive early.

glosses.notes: Used before a measure or noun to mean the whole or complete amount.

example_translations.translation: I drank the whole bottle of water.
The entire class arrived.
I finished the whole magazine.

glosses.notes: Used before a noun to mean the whole thing, period, or group.

example_translations.translation: I stayed at home the entire afternoon.
The whole plan changed.
He was busy the entire week.

glosses.notes: To put things in order or sort material into a clear arrangement.

examples.sentence: 出门前先把桌子整理一下。

example_translations.translation: I need to tidy up my room tonight.
The teacher asked us to organize our notes.
Before leaving, sort out the desk first.

glosses.notes: Describes something arranged in a clean and orderly way.

example_translations.translation: Her desk is always very neat.
Everyone is lined up very tidily.
These books are not arranged very neatly.

glosses.notes: The whole of something viewed together, not just one part.

examples.sentence: 从整体看，这个计划不错。
整体上看，这个计划不错。

example_translations.translation: Taken as a whole, this plan is pretty good.
Overall, this plan is pretty good.
This outfit feels comfortable overall.

glosses.notes: Used to say that something lasts through the whole day.

examples.sentence: 病了以后，他整天都在家。

example_translations.translation: He stays in the office all day.
After getting sick, he stayed at home all day.
I did not leave the house all day today.

secondary_glosses: for a full exact amount of
glosses.notes: Emphasizes that the full amount of time or quantity was reached.

examples.sentence: 我们整整等了两个小时。
这本书我看了整整一周。

example_translations.translation: We waited for a full two hours.
I spent a full week reading this book.
He studied Chinese for a full three years.

glosses.notes: Describes something that is straight, upright, or properly aligned.

example_translations.translation: Please place the photo straight.
He sits very upright.
Write the characters a little straighter.

glosses.notes: Describes something official, proper, or done in a formal way.

examples.sentence: 他已经正式参加工作了。

example_translations.translation: We officially start classes next week.
This is a formal talk.
He has already officially started working.

glosses.notes: A short form used in compound words for certificates, cards, and proofs.

example_translations.translation: He took out his work ID for me to see.
I left my student ID at home.
This shop needs to see the membership card first.

glosses.notes: Official documents that show identity or permission.

example_translations.translation: Do not forget to bring your ID documents when you go out.
They need to check your papers during the process.
Where did you put your ID documents?

glosses.notes: Facts or materials that prove whether something is true.

example_translations.translation: What he said has no evidence.
The police are looking for evidence.
These photos are the evidence.

glosses.notes: To show something is true, or a written proof in some contexts.

examples.sentence: 你能证明这本书是你的吗？
学校让我们开一个证明。

example_translations.translation: This matter proves that he is right.
Can you prove that this book is yours?
The school told us to get a certificate.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for pens, songs, and similar items
glosses.notes: A measure word used for some long items and some songs or teams.

examples.meaning_en: measure word for pens, songs, and similar items
measure word for pens, songs, and similar items
measure word for pens, songs, and similar items

example_translations.translation: I bought two pens.
I like this song very much.
I still have a flower in my hand.

glosses.notes: To support someone, an idea, or a decision.

examples.sentence: 这个决定得到了大家的支持。

example_translations.translation: My family all support me.
Thank you for always supporting us.
This decision received everyone's support.

glosses.notes: To pay money for something.

example_translations.translation: You can pay on your phone.
I will pay for dinner this time.
He paid the full cost.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for animals and one of a pair
glosses.notes: A measure word often used with animals and one of a matching pair.

examples.meaning_en: measure word for animals and one of a pair
measure word for animals and one of a pair
measure word for animals and one of a pair

example_translations.translation: There is a bird in the tree.
I bought two cats.
This shoe is a little big.

glosses.notes: Describes something straight, or movement that goes straight ahead.

example_translations.translation: This road is very straight.
Please go straight and do not turn right.
Her hair is long and straight.

glosses.notes: To broadcast something live, especially online or on television.

example_translations.translation: The teacher is livestreaming tonight.
I often watch live broadcasts on my phone.
This match is being broadcast live.

glosses.notes: Marks the end point in time before something happens.

examples.sentence: 我们直到周五才知道结果。

example_translations.translation: I did not go home until evening.
He did not sleep until he finished the book.
We did not know the result until Friday.

glosses.notes: To be worth a price, effort, or value.

examples.sentence: 我觉得这件衣服不值这个钱。

example_translations.translation: This ticket is worth one hundred yuan.
I think this piece of clothing is not worth this price.
Is this phone worth it or not?
